AboutUsArticle.title: About PlantBase
AboutUsArticle.subtitle: Your guide to the world of indoor plants

articles.article1: PlantBase is a modern online store dedicated to bringing nature closer to everyday life. We focus on carefully selected indoor plants that combine aesthetics, quality, and easy care.
articles.article2: Our goal is to make greenery accessible to everyone, whether you are just starting with houseplants or building your own urban jungle. Every product in our selection is chosen with an emphasis on quality, and we provide clear information to help you choose the right plant for your home or office.
articles.article3: We believe that plants are more than just decoration. They improve air quality, create a pleasant atmosphere, and bring life into any space. That is why we focus not only on selling plants, but also on inspiring and supporting people in creating healthier and more welcoming environments.

quality.title: Careful selection

faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.q1: How do I know when to water my plant?
faq.a1: Check the moisture of the soil by inserting your finger about 2–3 cm deep. If it feels dry, it is time to water. Each plant has different needs, so we recommend following the specific care instructions for each species.
faq.q2: What should I do if leaves are turning yellow?
faq.a2: Yellowing leaves can have multiple causes – overwatering, lack of light, or natural leaf aging. The most common cause is overwatering. Check whether the soil stays permanently wet.
faq.q3: Is this plant suitable for beginners?
faq.a3: Most plants in our range are selected with easy care in mind. Each product includes information about its light, watering, and environmental requirements.
faq.a4: Plants are packed in special packaging that protects the pot and leaves during transport. Standard delivery time is 2–4 business days.
